_README: THE SAFE CHUNK BAND PER VOICE, in characters. THIS FILE IS THE ONE TO EDIT.
min  the packer's MERGE FLOOR - short paragraphs travel together until a group reaches it
max  the packer's CAP        - a group may grow to here, and no chunk exceeds it
Every chunk a book renders falls between the two, except text that cannot be merged with
anything (a chapter heading, a list item, a scene-final line) - those are walls and stand alone.
WHERE THE NUMBERS COME FROM: a length sweep of the promoted checkpoint across the whole
spectrum. The band is where that checkpoint makes the fewest mistakes, and promotion writes it
here. Do NOT guess one from the training corpus - a rule derived from the corpus p25 was wrong
in production within a day (orpheus-finetune HIGGS_FIELD_NOTES 4n.37.19-21).
These OVERRIDE safeMinChars/safeMaxChars in higgs-models.json, which keeps the evidence notes.
A voice may add an 'mlx' or 'served' block to give one arm its own band; otherwise both arms
share the top-level pair. max may never exceed that arm's maxChars, and min must sit below max -
both refused by name, here and in narrator's engine/higgs/config.py.
